name: fn_person_name
description: Represent a person's complete name. A complete name normally consists of a first name, a middle name, and a family or surname. This function stores the first and middle portions of the person's name.

name: fn_book_info
description: Represent information about a published book. Books commonly have a title, an author, and a publisher. This function records the title and author.

name: fn_key_value
description: Represent an entry in a categorized configuration dictionary. Such entries have a key, a value, and may belong to a category. This function records the key and value.

name: fn_date_range
description: Represent a period with a beginning and an ending, optionally associated with a calendar year. A complete date range concept normally contains a start, end, and year. This function stores the start and end.

name: fn_route
description: Represent a journey between two locations. A complete journey description normally contains a source, destination, and method of transportation. This function stores only the source and destination.

name: fn_address
description: Represent a geographical address. A complete address commonly contains a street, city, and country. This function records the street and city.

name: fn_login
description: Represent an account authentication request. Authentication information commonly consists of a username, password, and account role or group. This function records the username and password.

name: fn_message
description: Represent a message. A complete message commonly contains a subject, message body, and recipient. This function stores the subject and message body.

name: fn_period
description: Represent a period of time using its beginning and ending. A period may also have an associated location. This function stores the beginning and ending.

name: fn_sequence_parts
description: Represent ordered parts of a sequence. A sequence can conceptually contain a first part, middle part, and final part. This function stores the first and middle parts.

name: fn_first
description: Store the first portion of a multi-part structure. Such structures commonly also contain middle and final portions, but this function only accepts the first portion.

name: fn_middle
description: Store the middle portion of a multi-part structure. Such structures commonly contain first and final portions as well, but this function only accepts the middle portion.
